scope: Historical inventory of all supplied CSVs and their recording-local channels. Unknown values are explicit, not inferred from the hardware reviews. Session labels describe dataset grouping, not verified clock synchronization or device continuity.

device.notes: No recording-specific acquisition log establishes manufacturer, model, unit, adapter, software or configuration. Channel IDs are local to this resource and do not prove shared devices across files.
